weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generality of IRS by not adequately addressing scenarios where the speedup may be less significant.
The paper does not provide sufficient theoretical justification for the choice of the threshold parameter gamma, which may affect the robustness of the certification.
The experimental results lack a comprehensive comparison with other state-of-the-art certification methods beyond just the baseline.
strengths: The introduction of Incremental Randomized Smoothing (IRS) represents a significant advancement in the field of robustness certification for deep neural networks.
The empirical results demonstrate substantial speedups in certification time, providing strong evidence for the effectiveness of the proposed method.
The paper clearly articulates its contributions and provides a well-structured methodology for reusing certification guarantees.
